name: Libri-Light: A Benchmark for ASR with Limited or No Supervision
description: Libri-Light is a massive speech dataset for self-supervised learning, unsupervised representations, and automatic speech recognition (ASR) with minimal supervision. Sourced from LibriVox public-domain audiobooks, it provides 60,000+ hours of unsegmented English speech audio organized into three nested subsets of increasing scale (small ~600h, medium ~6,000h, large ~60,000h) alongside small supervision splits (10 hours, 1 hour, 10 minutes), establishing a benchmark for foundation acoustic models like wav2vec 2.0.

license.name: Public Domain (LibriVox) / MIT (Code)
license.notes: Audio sourced from public domain LibriVox recordings; extraction toolkit released under MIT. Audio is organized into three nested subsets of increasing scale (small ~600h, medium ~6,000h, large ~60,000h), rather than disjoint additive splits.

verification.notes: Verified 60,000+ hours of audio, LibriVox public domain terms, and ICASSP 2020 publication DOI.
